spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense data, forms, and paragraphs.

top_nav.layout: Sticky header (z-50), backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-stone-200. px-6 h-16 flex items-center justify-between.
components: Logo: Emerald icon + Outfit font brand name
Nav Links: Clean, minimal gap-8, text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-900 transition-colors
Record Button: Primary CTA, rounded-full px-6 py-2 bg-emerald-600 text-white font-medium hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform

dashboard.layout: Control Room Grid. Dense and structured.
components: Summary Gauges/Cards (col-span-1): Balance, Cash Flow, Spending. Large numbers (Outfit), subtle subtext (Manrope). Use small Recharts sparklines inside cards if possible.
Balance Area Chart (col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3 row-span-2): Recharts area chart showing 30-day trend. Emerald gradient fill.
Expenses Structure (col-span-1 md:col-span-1 lg:col-span-1 row-span-2): Donut chart or dense list of top categories with color-coded dots.
Account Cards: Display bank icon/logo, Account Name, Balance (large INR), currency badge. Card hover: border-emerald-500 shadow-md transition-all.
Add Account CTA: Dashed border card, flex-col center, stone-400 text.

records.layout: Two-column bento: Left sidebar (w-64) for filters, Right content (flex-1) for list.
components: Sidebar: Clean inputs (search, sort, category checkboxes, type toggles). Minimal borders, use background tints for active states.
Records List: Grouped by date (overline text for dates). Each row: Category icon in circle, Note/Title, Account Name, Amount (right aligned, green for income, red for expense).

analytics.layout: Tabs at the top (Incomes vs Expenses). Main chart area + Data table below.
components: Tabs: Shadcn tabs but customized to be pill-shaped, bg-stone-100.
Charts: Recharts Bar or Line chart with custom Tooltip (rounded borders, shadow-lg, stone-900 text).
Data Table: Clean lines, border-b only, no vertical borders.
Type Tabs: Income / Expense / Transfer toggle.
Amount Input: Massive text (text-5xl Outfit), border-b only, text-center.
Category Picker: Grid of icons with text below.
Account Select & Date Picker: Clean Shadcn selects.

user_avatar.description: User profile picture for top navigation bar.

libraries.icons: lucide-react (since already installed, use this for consistency, avoid phosphor installation overhead unless necessary, but phosphor is allowed if agent prefers. We recommend lucide-react for standard SaaS apps)
libraries.components: shadcn/ui (dialog, tabs, select, input, form, popover, calendar)

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the font imports for 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' into your global CSS or Tailwind config and apply them to standard headings/body.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the primary Dashboard grid to ensure exact 'Control Room' bento structure. Avoid relying solely on rigid Shadcn Cards if they restrict layout.
For the Records filter sidebar, use Shadcn Form elements but style them minimally (no harsh borders, soft focus rings).
Ensure multi-currency displays format correctly (INR ₹ by default).
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, tabs). Example: `data-testid='add-record-btn'`.
The hero/nav elements should use the 'Crystal Glass' effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80).
Chart tooltips must match the theme (white background, stone-200 border, rounded-lg).
